label: Creature: ordered to a universal cause of being versus caused in being by some other being
resolution: CREATURE_1 (DEF-CREATURE, IsCreatureOfUniversalCause) is the q.13 a.5 sense: ordered to God as principle and cause, with God read as a cause of the being of every other being that causes x's being. CREATURE_2 (IsCausedInBeingByAnother) is the broad gloss: some other being, a secondary cause included, causes x's being. CREATURE_1 entails CREATURE_2 by definition. The converse is not definitional: the controls of specs/creature-senses.toml give a model in which a being is CREATURE_2 and not CREATURE_1. Every statement that speaks of creatures takes CREATURE_1: 'Everything other than the primary is CREATURE_1', 'Every creature having the selected perfection has it caused by the primary', 'The esse of every CREATURE_1 is received in some principle' (the q.7 a.2 reading, said of things made by God) and the formal facts of the Fourth-Way attribution readings. One statement passes between the senses: 'Whatever is CREATURE_2 is CREATURE_1' (b7d4eede-ab50-5522-8902-f33238fa234d; its antecedent is CREATURE_2 and its consequent CREATURE_1). Earlier its paraphrase glossed its consequent broadly, so that chaining it with the q.7 a.2 reading equivocated (the rejected first draft of #1494). It is now read with CREATURE_1 as consequent, so it is the substantive sense bridge, and its sense-fixed sibling 'Whatever is CREATURE_2 is CREATURE_1, sense-fixed' is derived (causedInBeingByAnotherIsCreature1) from the proved Fourth-Way consequence STMT-MAXIMAL-CAUSE-WITHOUT-DISTINCT-ESSE-CAUSE and the weak premise 'Whatever has its being caused is in act as to being'; b7d4eede follows from it by instantiation. Arguments that pass from CREATURE_2 to CREATURE_1 list one of the two in sense_bridges: OTHERS-ARE-CREATURES-FROM-PARTICIPATION (b7d4eede), and in specs/creature-senses.toml the derivation of the sense-fixed bridge (role conclusion), the instantiation to b7d4eede and the derivation of 'Whatever has its being caused by another has its esse received in some principle' (the sense-fixed bridge). SCOPE CONDITION (definition 80dea550) binds both senses: the divine processions are no instances of CausesIn c x esse with c distinct from x. TYPE-LEVEL ENFORCEMENT: the arguments of specs/creature-senses.toml bind sense-fixed sibling statements whose own Lean declarations name the sense constants: Whatever is CREATURE_2 is CREATURE_1, sense-fixed (CausedInBeingByAnotherIsCreature1) and The esse of every CREATURE_1 is received in some principle, sense-fixed (Creature1EsseIsReceived), and they declare term_senses CREATURE_1, so bind-check rejects a hypothesis that reaches the CREATURE_2 constant outside a listed sense bridge (checked: a variant instantiating the Creature-parametric 29e71e43 at IsCausedInBeingByAnother was rejected with other-sense-mentioned and statement-sense-not-instantiated). The siblings are tied to the legacy statements by two instantiation transcriptions (sense-fixed bridge gives b7d4eede; 29e71e43 gives the sense-fixed reception premise). REMAINING LEGACY SCOPE: b7d4eede, 29e71e43 and 612078bf keep their Creature-parametric declarations because merged arguments with frozen Challenges (Round 2, the Fourth-Way attribution readings) bind them; in those legacy arguments, which declare no term_senses, CREATURE_1 is fixed by the records and review only.
